description:
Missing from :erlang (resolve/unknown-import on all paths): element/2, binary_part/3, iolist_to_binary/1, iolist_size/1, integer_to_binary/2, atom_to_binary/2, is_map_key/2, error/3 (with error_info), binary_to_float/1 and binary_to_integer/1 as captures (&:erlang.f/1), and float_to_binary(f, [:short]) (spec allows only decimals:). Also missing: IO.iodata_to_binary/1, which Elixir defines as a delegate to :erlang.iolist_to_binary/1. Reproducers: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/03..12_*.fz, 26_improper_iodata.fz. Kernel binary_part/3 is fz-j8z.

Part of fz-mue (fz runs OTP's json.erl unchanged). Port and harness: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/.
